Definition: from G5228 and G3528; to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory:--more than conquer.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses hypernikáō where we would say to conquer overwhelmingly, to be more than conquerors. In Romans 8:37, the text says "in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hypernikáō I do not force more than it gives: to conquer overwhelmingly, to be more than conquerors.
